rv.q: A classic musical has been delivered with grace and elan.
Greenberg’s production absolutely does what it has to do, which is induce shivers of delight at every turn, keeping the wise-crack wit coming, and hitting you with one classic tune after another.
Overall, the show doesn't have the shimmer or the sassiness of the Eyre revival, nor the social grip and precision of Grandage's.

cn.t: Critics hail this expert revival as a witty triumph, with strong performances and expertly integrated songs and dance routines delivering consistent delight throughout.
